titles.title: 世子嬪にならない方法

description:
So-jin, disguised as a courtesan to catch the scene of a friend's affair

 Her father, Yeonguijeong, is confronted!

 Running away from her father, she drowns in the pool in her annex and is only exhausted.

 There she meets her naked man, who is somehow not unfamiliar to her...  …  ?

 It turns out that he was the man Sojin saved a year ago! Her heun begins to seduce her to regain her memory of her lost day through her exhaustion.

 Then, So-jin infiltrated the palace using Crown Prince's house to find her missing friend.

 But did she change her plans?

 So-jin, who has to move away from her house, has been given a ‘House Alert’!
